proposed_contract.scope: Exactly two distinct resolved PLAYED players; scalar explicit season; explicit subject/opponent; latest ORIGINAL one whole matchup. Subject/opponent/date/venue selection precedes selecting last one, with no participation cohort predicate. Qualify both names only on that selected canonical row.
proposed_contract.minimal_reuse: Use existing full-frame team summary selector without availability predicates, then existing filter_played with opponent_context=True. Preserve original selected row for Yes and No; display projection follows qualification. Existing FinderResult and answer_phrase renderer are plausible consumers; no new public field or result class is required.
proposed_contract.projection_boundary: Direct game_finder FinderResult.games drops canonical team/opponent IDs and is not a valid input to qualified participation. Full canonical selection must be retained before projection; do not infer sides from displayed labels.
proposed_contract.false_meaning: A fully qualified original game where at least one named player explicitly did_not_play means not BOTH. It does not mean neither. No original candidate, unknown/missing/unresolved/contradictory observation cannot become No.
proposed_contract.error_boundary: Participation qualification must run within protected execution or explicit error-to-result handling. Existing yes/no metadata postprocessing runs outside the execution exception boundary and cannot simply raise source errors.
proposed_contract.presentation: Existing original game ID/date remain visible for either answer. Participation predicates are checks, not matching cohort filters when truth is false. Preserve subject/opponent, season, original selection and both canonical names in truthful metadata/labels.
proposed_contract.reader_guards: Add bounded dedicated BOTH reader; retain existing scalar BOTH exclusion. Reject or retain unfinished N>1, qualifying/either/OR/mixed polarity, extra players/status/stat/outcome/period or unread clauses. Preserve legacy scalar and qualifying/window cohort semantics.
